item.title: Schiff threatens to investigate ABC, CBS for their Trump settlements if Dems take control of Congress
item.summary: Sen. Adam Schiff, D-Calif., warned news outlets, like ABC News and CBS News, that made settlements to President Donald Trump will face investigations if Democrats win back Congress.

item.title: Iran backlash forces Gulf allies toward Washington as regional tensions rise
item.summary: Saudi Arabia reportedly granted U.S. forces access to King Fahd Air Base for the first time since the Gulf War as Gulf states recalibrate their posture amid escalating Iranian attacks.

item.title: NASCAR driver Denny Hamlin's mother makes heartbreaking plea to county officials after deadly house fire
item.summary: Mary Lou Hamlin, mother of NASCAR driver Denny Hamlin, made an emotional plea for fire department funding after a deadly North Carolina house fire killed her husband.

item.title: Russian man who assaulted woman during Barron Trump FaceTime call sentenced to 4 years
item.summary: Russian MMA fighter Matvei Rumiantsev was sentenced to four years for assaulting a woman in London in an attack Barron Trump witnessed on FaceTime.

item.title: ‘Lovers’ Lane’ murders suspect nabbed decades after couple found dead in car
item.summary: Floyd William Parrott was charged with capital murder in the 1990 "Lovers' Lane" cold case killings of two Texas victims after 36 years unsolved.

item.title: Biden judge freezes Trump admin move against AI firm, fueling battle over security authority
item.summary: Ruling pauses effort to sideline Anthropic while drawing backlash and support over judicial role in Pentagon policy.

item.title: 'Ship has sailed': This is what Dems won't get in DHS deal after shunning GOP
item.summary: Senate Democrats claimed a political victory as the Homeland Security shutdown nears its end, but they secured none of the reforms they desired that started the closure in the first place.

item.title: FBI says 'malicious actors' targeted Patel's personal email, Iran-based hacking group claims responsibility
item.summary: The FBI says “malicious actors" targeted Director Kash Patel’s personal email, adding the information exposed was historical and not government-related.

item.title: Fights, arrests and police resistance follow Cincinnati's Opening Day celebrations in the city
item.summary: Mayor Aftab Pureval called post-Opening Day chaos in Cincinnati an outrage, demanding accountability after police reported violence and made arrests.

item.title: Cowboys' Dak Prescott nowhere to be found in ex-fiancée's family beach photos weeks after calling off wedding
item.summary: Dak Prescott's ex-fiancée Sarah Jane Ramos shared a beach photo carousel with her daughters, posting a faith-based message weeks after their split.
